title: RAW UNREVIEWED: an emptied vessel retains a surface condition that changes the next charge until cleaning
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED. Whole-account C0 offer: charge one vessel with a conditioning material, remove its bulk contents, refill with a fresh material, recover an affected second product, then clean the vessel before repeating the fresh charge. The apparatus condition persists separately from bulk contents and from reader reference memory. The same fresh input can yield different written product properties before versus after cleaning. No target gloss, historical source identification or completed reading is claimed.

design.phase: exploratory raw supply; no experiment selected or executed
design.whole_account: Prepare or condition a vessel with material A; draw A off and keep it separately; refill that same vessel with fresh material B; draw off a B-derived product carrying a property acquired through contact with the conditioned vessel; clean the vessel; charge fresh B again and obtain a product without that contact-acquired property. This is a hypothetical practical account, not an asserted medieval recipe or an English translation of Voynich text.

generative_steps: Contact(A,V) changes a separately represented surface condition of the same apparatus V; initial wall condition is fixed rather than fitted per occurrence.
BulkEmpty(V) removes the current liquid charge but does not automatically reset the surface condition; A and subsequent B remain distinct material participants.
Contact(B,V), followed by withdrawal, yields a B product with the contact-acquired property under the conditioned-surface branch.
Clean(V) resets the surface condition while preserving V identity; a repeated fresh-B charge yields the unconditioned product.
design.distinct_observable_consequence: A complete written continuation that refers to the same emptied vessel and to two separately recovered B products must distinguish their property before versus after cleaning, under one fixed participant/property construction. A bulk-content-only model with an emptied vessel and identical fresh B predicts identical products in both runs. The existing owned f101r text is the proposed place to seek that entire contrast; this producer has NOT found or aligned it. No absent output is counted as confirmation.
rivals: Independent entries/new vessel in each paragraph: history does not couple the products.
Persistent bulk mixture: the first material was never fully withdrawn; the second product reflects stored contents rather than an apparatus condition.
Same apparatus with bulk-empty reset: fresh B has the same property on both runs.
Merely repeated description or reader-state reload: repeated identity labels have no physically different product consequence.

novelty.difference: 175 couples actions through material held in a vessel and contrasts same/new/emptied device. This proposal explicitly separates a persistent apparatus-surface condition from zero bulk contents and requires a two-product contrast broken by cleaning. No existing P12 gloss or frozen occupancy test is rerun or repaired.
related_not_duplicate: IDEA000232/W35 concerns thermal co-treatment of connected material members; it has no later checking recipient and remains inconclusive. A later recipient cannot be invented for it.
IDEA000752 concerns prior steeping of spice and oil absorption versus perfume quality, not reused apparatus condition after bulk emptying.
IDEA000755 concerns protective coating of a wall against exposure, not a wall carrying a prior charge's property into a new product.
The IJ LINE_END_CARRY review concerns reader-state retention versus reset/reload. The same apparatus name alone cannot distinguish either model.

design.retained_positive_knowledge: Spaces, directed reusable composition, whole-form residuals and entry context remain required. This semantic account supplies a possible reason for context-sensitive descriptions, not a recovered parser. No q-, ch-, y-, p- or minim-series gloss is assigned.
assumptions_and_dependencies: One apparatus identity is explicitly written across the proposed record transitions; visual proximity, equal counts and repeated spelling alone cannot establish this.
Bulk withdrawal and apparatus cleaning are distinct operations and both must be paid in the complete reading; no invisible cleaning or remaining charge repairs.
Fresh B before and after cleaning has the same initial property under one fixed construction.
The product property is explicitly written and separately carried by the two B products; it is not supplied by an image or by the operation definition alone.
No contemporary microbial mechanism, numerical adsorption law or historical Vorlage is asserted. Contact-acquired property is a C0 semantic hypothesis.
why_it_could_fail: The three paragraphs may describe independent entries, so apparatus continuity is wrong.

The full text may provide no separately written emptied-apparatus reference, cleaning step or paired product property. That is missing construction capacity, not empirical disproof of all contact accounts.
A fitted surface condition could absorb arbitrary outcomes. Its initial state, update and cleaning reset must be fixed once, with no per-occurrence exceptions.
A bulk-residue reading may be observationally equivalent. The whole account must preserve that unresolved alternative rather than calling apparatus memory confirmed.
design.decision_consequence: If a complete shared reading pays apparatus identity, bulk withdrawal, cleaning and both output assertions and produces a contrast unavailable to the bulk-empty/new-device rivals, shortlist this account for a fixed exposed-data test. If it yields only repeated vessel names, or requires unwritten outputs/cleaning, park this offer without building a process engine. If both models give the same observable outputs, retain equivalence and do not choose meaning.
design.smallest_next_step_if_shortlisted: Author one complete three-paragraph account against the already owned reader, preserving every group and boundary, and state the apparatus, two batches, their output properties and cleaning dependency. No first-word gloss search or new data intake is needed. Do not implement a decoder/parser. A later root decision note must freeze exact finite writing choices and a total budget before a test.
